entities.summary: Steve Maslow at the Queen of Angeles Hospital in Los Angeles California, is an American sound engineer. He won three Academy Awards for Best Sound and has been nominated for four more in the same category. He also won the Bafta Award for "The Empire Strikes Back" and the Australian AACTA for "The Great Gatsby". He has worked on more than 200 films since 1978.
